name: contractor-plus
description: Contractor Plus monorepo — Vue/Vite frontend + Fastify/Prisma backend, packaged as a Windows desktop app with an independent backend Windows Service.

scripts.dev:web: pnpm build:shared && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c yellow,blue "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm --filter frontend dev:web"
scripts.dev:client: pnpm build:shared && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,green "pnpm --filter frontend dev:client" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && pnpm --filter frontend run electron:dev:client"
scripts.electron:dev: pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:backend && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,green "pnpm dev:frontend" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && pnpm --filter frontend run electron:dev"
scripts.desktop:reset: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const p=path.join(process.env.ProgramData||'C:\\ProgramData','ContractorPlus','config','service.json');try{fs.rmSync(p,{force:true});console.log('[desktop:reset] removed '+p+' — app will open setup mode on next launch')}catch(e){const locked=(e.code==='EPERM'||e.code==='EACCES');console.log('[desktop:reset] could not remove '+p+': '+e.message+(locked?' (ACL-locked config from a packaged install — run this in an elevated shell or uninstall the app)':''))}"
scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:frontend && pnpm build:backend
scripts.build:server: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm build:backend && pnpm build:backend-bundle
scripts.build:backend: pnpm --filter backend prisma:generate && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.package:server: pnpm clean && pnpm verify:versions && pnpm fetch:winsw && pnpm fetch:node && pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm build:backend && pnpm build:backend-bundle && pnpm --filter frontend exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml && pnpm verify:packaged
scripts.package:client: pnpm clean && pnpm verify:versions && pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter frontend build:client && pnpm --filter frontend exec electron-builder --config electron-builder-client.yml
scripts.publish:app: pnpm clean && pnpm verify:versions && pnpm fetch:winsw && pnpm fetch:node && pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm build:backend && pnpm build:backend-bundle && pnpm --filter frontend exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish always && pnpm verify:packaged
